why: ¶28 has the stranger name the two horses entered for the Wessex Cup: "Silver Blaze and Bayard."

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — get information to bet on
why: ¶28 has the stranger ask for "the straight tip" and whether Bayard could give Silver Blaze a hundred yards, and whether the stable have put money on him. A reader has reason to consider that he wants information to bet on.
